summary: Upstage Studio has a $0 Free organization-level plan with a daily-refilling usage quota shared across its agents, not 10 free runs for each agent. The official changelog says the per-agent offer was replaced in September 2026. Free includes all Studio features; jobs stop when quota is exhausted and resume after the next daily refill, with no rollover or Free overage. Current pricing shows a 100-page reference volume, but docs retain a launch note saying a later adjustment to 10 pages/day, so confirm the actual organization quota rather than relying on either number. Page equivalents depend on workflow nodes and model usage; Studio UI and Agents API runs share quota, while direct Console APIs remain separately PAYG billed. The separate paid-plan 7-day trial requires a payment method and automatically starts paid billing if not cancelled.
claim_steps: Open https://www.upstage.ai/pricing/studio and sign up at studio.upstage.ai on Free; the Free plan states no payment details required.

Check organization settings/subscription for the actual daily quota. It is shared across agents; do not assume a fresh 10-run allowance per agent. Public pricing/docs disagree on the post-launch page allowance.
Build a document workflow and monitor node/model usage against the shared quota. When Free quota runs out, wait for the next daily refill; no Free overage or unused-quota rollover.
Distinguish Studio/Agents API quota from direct Console API PAYG charges. Do not activate the separate card-required 7-day paid-plan trial unless you intend to manage its automatic paid renewal.

social_proof.title: Upstage changelog — Studio subscription pricing
social_proof.text: The 10 free runs per agent are replaced by a usage quota shared across your organization.

social_proof.title: Upstage Studio current Free pricing
social_proof.text: Free is the default plan. Everything in Studio. There is no feature limit, only a daily usage allowance. Once you use it up, you wait until it refills the next day.

social_proof.title: Upstage Studio — quota caveat
social_proof.text: The Free plan's 100 pages per day is a launch allowance that runs through September 21, 2026. It will then be adjusted to 10 pages per day, and we will announce the change in advance.
